name: the design sized to the hands: scale and detail conditioned on crew, upkeep, space and colours
what_it_changes: P02 says the room settles what its mark will show. In these rooms the design is conditioned by what the room can build and keep: its scale and detail depend on the crew it can assemble, the upkeep it can sustain, the space it can protect and the colours available.
why: Cut rules R1 and R2 (tree-D4.md), with R1a (the level): the key's lines, read whole in _analysis/d4a02_keys/add-condition_P02_T4-006.txt, state one shared change to P02. R1a: T3-004 holds 10 of the 22 rooms and T3-033 6, so the branch is declared at the fourth order. 'The preferred design is conditional on assembling a sufficiently large crew' (anaheimducks); 'Further detail depended on the ability to maintain it' (strangerthings); 'A small pool of builders makes compactness a condition of finishing' (evex). These are the labelers' how sentences.
